name: 投资日历
description_zh: 查财经事件时间，分析事件影响，支持全球 20+ 国家、单月 400+ 条事件，并提供 FOMC/非农/CPI 等重大事件的市场影响手册辅助决策。
description_en: Track economic events and analyze their market impact. Covering 20+ countries​ with over 400 events per month, the platform provides decision-making support through expert guides on high-impact releases—including FOMC announcements, Non-Farm Payrolls (NFP), and CPI data.
